v1.name: V1 readiness
v1.status: Supervised pilot only; reported live rollout CSS/502 defects and full premium AWS site delivery unverified
v1.summary: Oct 28 production UI audit documented stylesheet 404s during overlapping web releases and an intermittent ALB 502; #779 repair is open, locally tested only. Merged customer checkout and chat improvements are not repeated live payment-to-handoff evidence. No complete post-#329 AWS premium builder delivery or 3 independently accepted customer websites; draft Stromation #330 gets no implemented credit.

v2.name: V2 readiness
v2.status: More dashboard/chat and guarded connectors merged; five-worker real-provider outcomes unverified
v2.summary: Oct 27–28 merged team chat actions, rebuild payment sheet, and Housecall Pro/Jotform preview connectors improve available code paths; preview and managed-read flags remain off. No proof of delivered recaps, recurring real-provider work for all five employees, or repeat customer outcomes.

v3.name: V3 / Full 10/10 vision
v3.status: Progress index; production rollout reliability evidence reduces confidence
v3.summary: Confirmed reported release-time CSS errors and intermittent ALB 502, while the fix is open, offset unproven code gains. Full supported SaaS, autonomous custom-agent delivery, repeated premium sites, measured mature autonomy, unit economics and founder workload remain unverified.

autonomyProof.note: Representative success/attempt denominator is still unavailable; do not imply the 95–99% V3 mature target has been measured.

founderWorkload.note: Darius minutes are not comprehensively separated from operator effort, customer approvals or specialist review.
